_comment: AD-1 PRIMARY GATE LIVES IN THE REFERENCE GRAPH, NOT HERE.
Never add a `paths` mapping to this file. A repo-wide path alias would let
packages/domain resolve packages/db and every infra SDK again, which silently
deletes the only enforcement layer that `// eslint-disable` cannot switch off.
Cross-package resolution happens through pnpm workspace symlinks +
package.json `types`, gated by each package's own `dependencies`.
